description: Synthetic end-to-end healthcare trace: TakeCare note reads through the qualified ProvidEHR bounded-read boundary -> ambient extraction and append-only clinician review -> OpenBody whole-person observation envelopes and state snapshot -> Metabolog temporal state graph. Not patient data, not a clinical validation claim.

rules: A ProvidEHR ambient envelope carries quality flag clinician_reviewed; review stays epistemic_status reported (never clinician_validated) and is never uncertainty.
The consumer refuses an ambient candidate without clinician_reviewed (unreviewed_ambient_claim) and never builds state on it.
The consumer re-derives provenance: every listed input has its envelope with the same canonical digest; candidates keep their envelope's source, origin, epistemic status and missingness.
Revoked consent and revoked sources reach OpenBody as host revocations and are recorded as exclusions, never ingested.
A stale-only entry is kept with provenance but produces no current state.

upstream.note: Synthetic TakeCare-shaped note reads; narrative uses the synthetic ambient line profile documented in crates/ambient-evidence/src/takecare.rs.

cases.name: missing_provenance/list-detail-not-reconciled
cases.rule: The qualified boundary binds the note list record and its detail; a detail that names another note is refused before any ambient step.

cases.name: missing_provenance/wrong-patient
cases.rule: A detail for another patient is refused by the boundary (patient binding).

cases.name: missing_provenance/unqualified-version-field
cases.rule: An explicit version field has no qualified semantics; the boundary refuses it rather than ignoring it.

cases.name: missing_provenance/not-the-takecare-connector
cases.rule: The adapter only accepts reads bound to the qualified takecare.leyr connector.

cases.name: missing_provenance/source-digest-changes-with-content
cases.rule: The record digest is the boundary's original-source digest: a different narrative is a different record version.

cases.name: revoked_consent
cases.rule: Withdrawn capture consent is a host revocation; the statement is excluded, not ingested.

cases.name: missing_provenance/record-digest-removed
cases.rule: An envelope without source.record_digest is structurally invalid.

cases.name: unreviewed_ambient_claim
cases.rule: The 1.0 assembler cannot see review; it accepts the snapshot and the trace consumer policy refuses the candidate.

cases.name: imputed_control
cases.rule: An imputed gap-fill with a digest-bound parent stays a candidate outside basis.

cases.name: imputed_as_observed/envelope-relabelled
cases.rule: An envelope that says observed but carries a derivation is structurally invalid.

cases.name: imputed_as_observed/snapshot-basis
cases.rule: A re-digested snapshot that moves the imputed candidate into basis is rejected by validate_state.

cases.name: stale_source
cases.rule: A symptom older than the 7-day window at as_of is stale_only and blocked.

cases.name: control/base-trace
cases.rule: The base trace is ingested; see outcomes and states.

cases.name: revoked_consent
cases.rule: The withdrawn-consent statement is recorded as an exclusion and never becomes evidence.

cases.name: stale_source
cases.rule: The stale-only entry keeps its evidence but creates no current state.

cases.name: unreviewed_ambient_claim
cases.rule: An ambient candidate without clinician_reviewed is refused and no state is built on it.

cases.name: missing_provenance/candidate-record-digest-removed
cases.rule: A re-digested snapshot whose candidate lost its record digest is refused.

cases.name: missing_provenance/envelope-not-supplied
cases.rule: Every listed input needs its envelope with the same canonical digest.

cases.name: missing_provenance/missingness-altered
cases.rule: A candidate's missingness must equal its envelope's.

cases.name: imputed_control
cases.rule: An imputed candidate is kept as non-measurement evidence and never becomes state.

cases.name: imputed_as_observed
cases.rule: A re-digested snapshot that relabels the imputed candidate as observed and puts it in basis is refused.

cases.name: contract_unpinned
cases.rule: A snapshot bound to other schema bytes is refused before anything else.

cases.name: snapshot_tampered
cases.rule: A value change without a matching snapshot digest is refused.

cases.name: subject_mismatch
cases.rule: The consumer only ingests the subject its custodian bound.
cases.subject: subject:openbody:someone-else
